faq_metadata.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_metadata.description: Authoritative FAQ policies, delivery structure, and licensing terms for Business and Personal AI Training.

walkaway_guarantee.summary: Walk away owing nothing if not satisfied after the first 5 days of completed training.
walkaway_guarantee.refundable_installments: Strictly zero advance payment required; progressive installment invoicing.

ip_licensing.policy_name: Full Production IP and Apache 2.0 Licensing
ip_licensing.summary: All code, workflows, custom tooling, and multi-agent infrastructure developed belong 100% to the client. All written guides, digital curricula, and documentation are licensed under Apache 2.0.

delivery_schedule.business_flagship: 70 days total: 30 days live training + 30 days guidance and materials (30 working days over 8 weeks with 8 - 10 recovery days, 4 hours per day)
delivery_schedule.personal_flagship: 60 days total: 30 days live training + 30 days guidance and materials (30 working days over 6 weeks with 8 - 10 recovery days, 4 hours per day)
delivery_schedule.individual_service: 10 days total: 5 days live training + 5 days dedicated support (4 hours per day)

cohort_rules.business_flagship: Up to 10 participants included in base tier; additional seats at +$200 USD per seat scaled by country parity
cohort_rules.individual_business: Covers 1 to 10 cohort seats with parity pricing

support_period_payments.flagship_support: Additional $500 USD for 30 days support, paid in two installments: $250 USD after 15 days of support and $250 USD after 30 days of support.
support_period_payments.individual_service_support: Additional $50 USD for 5 days support, paid in a single installment of $50 USD after 5 days of support.
support_period_payments.payment_terms: Zero upfront payment for support; payments are due strictly after verifying completed support delivery. Subject to the 6 Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) tiers.
